designs.design_A:
Image 1 is the STYLE reference only (do not copy that man: different hair, face and clothes).

Art style EXACTLY like image 1: soft modern anime illustration, thin coloured lineart, soft cel shading with one soft-edged shadow layer, romantic otome-game card quality, clean and calm. Realistic adult proportions (not chibi), a handsome, masculine face with a clear jawline.

Gaku, 29, a solo winter-camping live streamer: tall, broad-shouldered, quiet and a little clumsy with words, gentle and dependable like a big older brother; a small, shy, warm smile, calm kind eyes.

Look A: short black hair, a little messy, thick straight eyebrows, narrow dark-brown eyes, lightly tanned skin. A chunky cream cable-knit fisherman sweater under an open olive-green mountain parka. Sitting on a low camp chair by the fire, holding an enamel mug in both hands, looking at the viewer with a small shy smile. Upper body, centred.

Background: a winter lakeside campsite at night — a crackling campfire in a ring of stones casting warm amber light on him from the RIGHT side, a canvas tent glowing faintly behind, dark pine trees, a frozen blue lake, light snow on the ground and a starry navy-blue sky; cold blue moonlight from the LEFT. Warm amber vs cold blue.

Wide 16:9 illustration. No text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no speech bubbles, no UI.

Avoid: chibi, super-deformed, realistic photo, 3D render, extra fingers, deformed hands, readable text, glossy airbrush, heavy bloom, silver / pink / red / platinum hair, glasses, sunglasses.
